capabilities.text: Set the object's length
Read a vernier caliper
capabilities.note: verSHion has only the ruler; no instrument choice.

capabilities.text: Read a micrometer
capabilities.note: verSHion has only the ruler; no instrument choice.

capabilities.text: Use a metric ruler 15 to 100 cm long
Use an inch ruler, 6 to 20 in long
capabilities.note: The inch ruler's length rides on the cm choices (30 cm drew a 12 in ruler); checked by hand that it changes over Imperial alone.

capabilities.text: Set how finely the ruler is marked
Read lengths to one estimated digit or to the nearest mark
capabilities.note: read_to alone renders the same; it shows through the answer key line (checked by hand against answer=true alone).

capabilities.text: Choose the object on the ruler: marbles, rock, cube or metal cylinder
Set where the object's left end sits
capabilities.evidence: changes:offset=2.0 + handle:drag:slide the object along the ruler

capabilities.text: Put magnifiers on the object's ends
Set how many numbered marks the magnifier shows
capabilities.note: Checked by hand that mag_marks changes the render over the magnifiers alone.

capabilities.text: Draw dashed lines from the object's ends down to the ruler
capabilities.note: Checked by hand that dashes changes the render over Marbles alone.

capabilities.text: Set the caliper's least count: 0.1, 0.05 or 0.02 mm
Print the least count on the slider or leave it off
Read the micrometer to its marks (0.01 mm) or to one estimated digit (0.001 mm)
Type the caliper or micrometer reading, or pick one at random
Give the caliper or micrometer a zero error, and draw it closed too
Put nothing, a block, a cylinder, a ball or a wire in the jaws, drawn to size with a short label
Show the caliper or micrometer with its close-up, or the instrument alone
Show the close-up alone, without the instrument
capabilities.note: Our ruler options are ruler with magnifiers, ruler only, or ruler with one magnifier above; no close-up alone.

capabilities.text: Add a chart title
Print an answer key line with the reading (and any correction)
